 Jonathan Kuminga records double-double in loss Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Timberwolves Correspondent | Mon, Oct 26th 2026, 11:39pm EDT 
 Jonathan Kuminga scored ten points (4-10 FG, 0-4 3PT, 2-4 FT) and grabbed ten rebounds in Monday's 127-125 OT loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Kuminga wasn't very effective as a scorer on Monday night, but he was able to finish with ten rebounds, which completed a double-double for him. He will continue to be a viable fantasy asset for as long as he continues to start for Minnesota.
